claim.en: Working longer hours gets more done.
claim.zh: 工作时间越长，做的事越多。

grade_why.en: Careful analysis of detailed historical factory records, consistent with later field data, but not experimental.
grade_why.zh: 基于详细历史工厂记录的严谨分析，与后来的现场数据一致，但不是实验研究。

evidence.en: Economist John Pencavel analysed records of British munition workers, most of them women, in the First World War. Below a threshold, output was proportional to hours; above it, output rose at a decreasing rate. Summaries of the full text report a threshold near 49 hours a week, and a six-day 48-hour week out-producing a seven-day 70-hour one.
evidence.zh: 经济学家 Pencavel 分析了第一次世界大战期间英国军工厂工人（多数是女工）的记录：低于某个门槛时，产出与工时成正比；超过之后，产出以递减的速度增长。对全文的转述提到，门槛在每周 49 小时左右，六天 48 小时的一周比七天 70 小时的一周产出还略高。

caveats.en: The data are from wartime manual work, not software. The abstract gives only the shape of the curve; the 49, 48 and 70 hour figures come from summaries of the full text, which we have not checked line by line.
caveats.zh: 数据来自战时的体力劳动，不是软件工作。摘要只描述了曲线的形状；49、48、70 小时这几个数字来自对全文的转述，我们没有逐行核对过。

boss_line.en: In the best-known study of long hours, output rose ever more slowly past a threshold, and a six-day 48-hour week is reported to have beaten a seven-day 70-hour week.
boss_line.zh: 在关于长工时最有名的研究里，超过某个门槛后产出越涨越慢；据报道，六天 48 小时的一周，产出超过了七天 70 小时的一周。

change_my_mind.en: Measured output from our own team showing no drop in output per hour at 55 hours or more over several months.
change_my_mind.zh: 我们自己团队连续几个月的数据显示，每周 55 小时以上时单位工时产出并没有下降。
